summary: Security update for the Linux Kernel RT (Live Patch 8 for SUSE Linux Enterprise 16)
details:
This update for the SUSE Linux Enterprise Kernel 6.12.0-160000.29.1 fixes various security issues

The following security issues were fixed:

- CVE-2025-54518: AMD-SN-7052: CPU OP Cache Corruption (bsc#1264096).
- CVE-2026-23437: net: shaper: protect late read accesses to the hierarchy (bsc#1261845).
- CVE-2026-31406: xfrm: Fix work re-schedule after cancel in xfrm_nat_keepalive_net_fini() (bsc#1261630).
- CVE-2026-46300: FragNesia attack: another xfrm/esp based local root exploit (bsc#1265224).
- CVE-2026-46333: ptrace: slightly saner 'get_dumpable()' logic (bsc#1265384).
